strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: The Rust runtime advances a headless continuation from an admitted retry task into the targeted retry task.run execution step.
The targeted retry delegates to the existing controlled verifier execution path and ExecuteProcess permission checks.
Headless retry-run decisions and retry task outcomes are bounded ledger state without raw workspace/provider/process data.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with supporting controlled_verification_execution and persistent_structured_ledger.
answers.new_capability: headless.continue_once can run one explicitly targeted, already-admitted verification recovery retry task.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: Direct task.run and generic headless candidate selection require caller-owned routing or non-domain-specific selection after M16.1 retry admission.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Headless callers remain unable to complete the admitted retry execution step through the continuation contract.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M15.1 hardened apply-time WriteWorkspace, M15.2 hardened provider AccessNetwork, and M16.1 admitted retry tasks; this phase runs one admitted retry task with route-scoped evidence.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The existing headless.continue_once method is extended.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The response returns the existing bounded task-run retry outcome and next route tied to actual execution.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: A valid continuation appends the controlled retry TaskRunning and verifier outcome evidence through existing task.run.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: It advances the replay-safe apply -> retry-verify path without caller-owned RPC switching.
answers.milestone_progress: Moves M16 from retry admission to retry execution, the next concrete apply-verify completion transition.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M16.2 updates the deterministic current phase manifest. Review must confirm targeted retry task execution behavior, not a headless route wrapper.

exit_criteria: headless.continue_once accepts bounded verification_recovery_retry_run_target evidence with explicit retry-run authorization
current aggregate progress fingerprint and sequence are checked before retry TaskRunning
valid target/proposal/apply/fingerprint evidence runs exactly one already-admitted verification recovery retry task
replayed continuation_id returns the same retry task outcome without duplicate HeadlessContinuationDecisionRecorded, TaskRunning, ToolExecutionRequested, or terminal verifier evidence
stale progress or stale target/provenance fingerprints fail before TaskRunning
response includes bounded verification_recovery_retry outcome and next-route evidence
direct task.run retry behavior and generic headless.continue_once task selection remain compatible
no proposal.apply, workspace mutation, provider execution, generic shell, git, network, service, scheduler, automatic recovery, or VSIX policy decision is added
bounded evidence excludes raw prompts, provider responses, file content, diffs, commands, stdout/stderr, environment values, secrets, absolute paths, and canonical paths
next_phase_candidate_notes: After M16.2 merge, assess whether M16 needs a bounded failed-retry recovery continuation or can move toward closeout. Do not add another route/report wrapper.
